Gave GPT-6 Astra a few renders of our office scan. It came back with a full Blender rebuild — 50 desks, 62 chairs, walls, blinds — aligned to the scan within 2 cm and exported to USD. Dropped it straight into Newton with a G1 walking through it. One prompt → a humanoid gym. 🤯 pic.twitter.com/4tzDC42jwS
